changelog: Say "stop" — or "থামো" in Bengali — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and the keyboard stops listening, so a finished message never needs a reach for the stop button. Gboard only offers this on Pixel phones in English; here it works on any phone in both languages. Nothing is deleted — everything you dictated stays in the message — and the undo button still works afterwards. Saying the word inside a longer sentence still types it as normal text.
